relevance_note: Case report of one male with a novel LAMP2 variant: 'Variant annotation results showed a hemizygous 1 bp deletion, c.453delT, in LAMP2 (NM_002294)'.
method_note: Built by a short Python script from my own reading; every span checked verbatim by script. No tables in the paper. Labels: proband = 'patient' (rule 5); mother = 'mother of patient' (described as affected: died of suspected postpartum DCM); older brother = 'older brother of patient' (targeted testing for the variant was negative, so no variant row). The father is mentioned only as signing consent and the pedigree is only in Fig. 3, so he gets no row. 'Family history of sudden cardiac death' is not attributed to a named person and is not recorded as a feature. Mother: 'suspected postpartum DCM' is hedged, so it is recorded only as cause_of_death, not as an observed feature or checklist item; 'probably the mother was a carrier' is hedged and not a test result, so she has no variant row and the proband's inheritance is 'not reported'. Pathogenicity: the formal ACMG classification is 'likely pathogenic' (recorded); the abstract and genetic counseling text call it a 'pathogenic variant'. Possible tension: EP workup was 'negative for the induction of ventricular arrhythmias' (recorded as excluded 'inducible ventricular arrhythmias'), while the abstract reports '2 episodes of ventricular fibrillation within 2 years' (observed; VT/VF checklist observed). Not a direct contradiction (inducibility vs spontaneous episodes), but the VF episodes are mentioned only in the abstract. Checklist judgments: 'dilated or hypokinetic LV' observed from moderate contractile dysfunction with LVEF 45% although dilation was absent ('without any evidence of dilation'); 'supraventricular tachycardia' observed from atrial tachycardia; 'atrioventricular block' observed from the Fig. 1 legend ('2:1 AV block'); 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' observed from distal weakness plus biopsy findings, although proximal weakness is not stated. Ages: HCM diagnosis 'one year before' age 16 and Danon diagnosis 'upon admission' at 17 give no directly stated age at onset or diagnosis, so both are 'not reported'; last evaluation = 17 years. Vital status of the proband is not stated explicitly. Genome build of chrX coordinate not printed. 'Normal' rule: 'No other clinical exams was conducted' excludes nothing.
